description.en:
* This field and the body field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one of them; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
* Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).

* 图片二进制文件，最大10MB。

description.en:
* This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one of them; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
* Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
* When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body.  
* When invoking via the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.

descriptions.zh:
#### 本接口适用场景 * 阿里云电子面单识别，是阿里云官方自研OCR文字识别产品，适用于自动提取面单上的手机号进行拨打收件人号码或发短信，减少快递员拨号时间；可快速定位面单上的所需信息，提升快递转运效率。 * 阿里云OCR产品基于阿里巴巴达摩院强大的AI技术及海量数据，历经多年沉淀打磨，具有服务稳定、操作简易、实时性高、能力全面等几大优势。 * 本接口图片示例

#### 本接口核心能力 |分类 |概述| |---|---------| |图像增强|默认支持图像增强，包括图像自动旋转、畸变自动矫正、模糊图片自动增强等能力。| |全字段识别|智能识别快递运单上所包含的全部字段。| |多类型覆盖|支持模糊、光照不均、透视畸变、任意背景等低质量图像识别。| |高精度识别|识别准确率可达93%。| #### 如何使用本接口 |步骤|概述| |--|---| |1|开通 [车辆物流识别](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_public_cn) 服务。开通服务前后，您可以通过[体验馆](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=logistics&subtype=waybill#intro)免费体验本功能识别效果。| |2|购买[电子面单识别资源包](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_logistics_dp_cn_20211103160032_0823%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D)。本API会赠送免费额度，可使用免费额度测试。您也可以不购买资源包，系统会通过“[按量付费](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html)”方式按实际调用量自动扣款。| |3|可以参照[调试页面](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeWaybill?sdkStyle=dara)提供的代码示例完成API接入开发。接入完成后，调用API获取识别结果。如果使用子账号调用接口，需要阿里云账号（主账号）对RAM账号进行授权。创建RAM用户的具体操作，请参考：[创建RAM用户。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html)文字识别服务提供一种系统授权策略，即**AliyunOCRFullAccess**。具体授权操作，请参见[在用户页面为RAM用户授权。](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html)| #### 重要提示 |类型|概述| |----|-------------------| |图片格式|
  • 本接口支持：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、TIFF、WebP。暂不支持PDF格式。
| |图片尺寸|
  • 图片长宽需要大于15像素，小于8192像素。
  • 长宽比需要小于50。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
  • 如需达到较好识别效果，建议长宽均大于500px。
| |图片大小|
  • 图片二进制文件不能超过10MB。
  • 图片过大会影响接口响应速度，建议使用小于1.5M图片进行识别，且通过传图片URL的方式调用接口。
| |其他提示|
  • 接口响应速度和图片中的文字数量有关，如果图片中文字数量越多，接口响应可能越慢。
  • 接口会自动处理反光、扭曲等干扰信息，但会影响精度。请尽量选择清晰度高、无反光、无扭曲的图片。
| |相关能力|
  • [云市场电子面单识别。](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi00043511.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.4efc4288F9Ffm7#sku=yuncode3751100001)
|
descriptions.en:
#### Scenarios for This API * Alibaba Cloud Electronic Waybill Recognition is an OCR text recognition product independently developed by Alibaba Cloud. It is suitable for automatically extracting phone numbers from waybills to dial recipients or send text messages, reducing the time couriers spend on dialing. It can quickly locate required information on waybills and improve logistics transfer efficiency. * Alibaba Cloud OCR products are built upon DAMO Academy’s advanced AI technologies and massive datasets, refined over many years. They offer several key advantages: stable service, simple operation, high real-time performance, and comprehensive capabilities. * Sample image for this API:

#### Core Capabilities of This API |Category|Overview| |---|---------| |Image Enhancement|Image enhancement is enabled by default, including automatic image rotation, distortion correction, and enhancement of blurry images.| |Full-Field Recognition|Intelligently recognizes all fields on logistics waybills.| |Multi-Type Coverage|Supports recognition of low-quality images, such as blurry images, uneven lighting, perspective distortion, and arbitrary backgrounds.| |High-Accuracy Recognition|Recognition accuracy can reach 93%.| #### How to Use This API |Step|Overview| |--|---| |1|Activate the [Vehicle Logistics Recognition](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_public_cn) service. Before or after activation, you can freely test the recognition performance of this feature in the [Experience Center](https://duguang.aliyun.com/experience?type=logistics&subtype=waybill#intro).| |2|Purchase an [Electronic Waybill Recognition resource plan](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ocr_logistics_dp_cn&request=%7B%22ord_time%22:%221:Year%22,%22order_num%22:1,%22pack%22:%22ocr_logistics_dp_cn_20211103160032_0823%22,%22flowout_spec%22:%22500%22%7D). This API provides a free quota for testing. Alternatively, you may choose not to purchase a resource plan; the system will automatically charge based on actual usage via the [pay-as-you-go](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/295347.html) billing method.| |3|Refer to the code samples provided on the [debug page](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/ocr-api/2021-07-07/RecognizeWaybill?sdkStyle=dara) to complete API integration. After integration, invoke the API to obtain the classification result. If you use a RAM user to call this API, the Alibaba Cloud account (primary account) must grant authorization to the RAM user. For instructions on creating a RAM user, see [Create a RAM user](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93720.html). The OCR service provides a system authorization policy named **AliyunOCRFullAccess**. For details on authorization, see [Grant permissions to a RAM user on the Users page](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/116146.html).| #### Important Notes |Type|Overview| |----|-------------------| |Image Format|
  • This API supports PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIFF, and WebP formats. PDF format is not currently supported.
| |Image Dimensions|
  • Image width and height must be greater than 15 pixels and less than 8192 pixels.
  • The aspect ratio (length-to-width ratio) must be less than 50.
  • To achieve better recognition results, we recommend that both width and height exceed 500 pixels.
  • To achieve better recognition results, we recommend that both width and height exceed 500 pixels.
| |Image Size|
  • The binary file size of the image must not exceed 10 MB.
  • Larger images may affect API response speed. We recommend using images smaller than 1.5 MB and invoking the API by passing an image URL.
| |Other Tips|
  • API response speed depends on the amount of text in the image; more text may lead to slower responses.
  • The API automatically handles interference such as glare and distortion, but this may affect accuracy. Please use images with high definition, no glare, and no distortion whenever possible.
| |Related Capabilities|
  • [Alibaba Cloud Marketplace Electronic Waybill Recognition](https://market.aliyun.com/products/57124001/cmapi00043511.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.4efc4288F9Ffm7#sku=yuncode3751100001).
|
